_comment: Hard rules of the desk's Skeptic and Scout (live/desk.py). Never decided by an AI. Owner, 2026-10-10: the 'AI Trading Desk' design (Scout, News, Sentiment, Charts, Skeptic, Chief) on this project's own percentages and risks. Changing a value is a reviewed change in GitHub. Owner, 2026-10-11: take profit 3-5% from the entry, tuned later by the leader with what is learned; a coin in a bull run lets its longs run with the trailing stop, at the usual risk ('arriesgar algo no todo'). Leader, 2026-10-11, from the 30-day real-data check: the 5% cap cut the desk from +18.7% (no band) to +6.1% (3-5% band), so target_max_pct is off and the 3% floor stays; the 3-5% band is still measured every Monday as 'mesa_meta_3_5'.
